notes: ABox contraction on a many-valued relation (located_in: transitive, cardinality:many), paired with physics-replace-0013: removes "CERN is located in Geneva", a stored fact. Yes/no questions are the natural form because the relation is many-valued (a wh-question about CERN's city has several answers, Meyrin among them). Cardinality question: is CERN located in Switzerland; removing one location says nothing about the others, so the answer stays yes. The one related question asks the city of the Large Hadron Collider (transitivity through "the LHC is at CERN"); caveat: the LHC is a ring under the France-Switzerland border near Geneva, so "Geneva" is not the one fair answer. Derived: whether CERN is in the city that hosts the WHO headquarters, and in the one that hosts the ICRC headquarters (both composition on a fact stored about Geneva by name; Meyrin hosts neither); the two share one shape. The revision's country and time-zone questions are not reused, since CERN is stored as being in Switzerland on its own. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
